script.code:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       DATE_FORMAT(n.t + INTERVAL 10 MINUTE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lease_until,
       CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       j.command,
       j.is_deleted,
       j.organization_id,
       j.picking_id,
       j.job_status,
       j.row_version,
       j.attempt_count,
       j.lease_owner,
       DATE_FORMAT(j.lease_expires_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lease_expires_at,
       (j.lease_expires_at > n.t) AS lease_live,
       j.progress_percent,
       j.progress_message,
       IF(JSON_VALID(j.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.request_payload, '$.operation')), NULL) AS operation,
       IF(JSON_VALID(j.prepared_payload), CAST(JSON_EXTRACT(j.prepared_payload, '$.fc') AS CHAR), NULL) AS fc,
       IF(JSON_VALID(j.prepared_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.prepared_payload, '$.picking_no')), NULL) AS picking_no,
       IF(JSON_VALID(j.prepared_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.prepared_payload, '$.snapshot.to_status')), NULL) AS snap_to_status,
       IF(JSON_VALID(j.prepared_payload), CAST(JSON_EXTRACT(j.prepared_payload, '$.snapshot.gds') AS CHAR), NULL) AS snap_gds,
       IF(JSON_VALID(j.prepared_payload), CAST(JSON_EXTRACT(j.prepared_payload, '$.gd_ids_all') AS CHAR), NULL) AS gd_ids_all,
       (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(s.step_name ORDER BY s.step_name)
          FROM gd_publish_step s
         WHERE s.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_DRguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND s.job_id = '{{node:code_node_DRguard.data.jobId}}'
           AND s.is_deleted = 0
           AND s.step_name IN ('FC_F0', 'FC_HOLD', 'FC_GDS', 'FC_ABORT', 'FC_REVIEW')) AS fc_steps
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN gd_async_job j
    ON j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_DRguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.id = {{node:code_node_DRguard.data.jobId}}

script.code:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       j.job_status,
       j.row_version,
       j.lease_owner,
       (j.lease_expires_at > n.t) AS lease_live,
       j.progress_percent,
       CAST((SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(e.id AS CHAR), 'status', e.job_status,
                                              'fcd', JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.request_payload, '$.fcd_ref')),
                                              'gd_id', JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.request_payload, '$.gd_id')),
                                              'due', (e.next_attempt_at IS NULL OR e.next_attempt_at <= n.t),
                                              'live', (e.lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND e.lease_expires_at > n.t),
                                              'code', e.error_code,
                                              'msg', e.error_message,
                                              'queued', DATE_FORMAT(e.queued_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'),
                                              'finished', DATE_FORMAT(e.finished_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')))
               FROM gd_async_job e
              WHERE e.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_DRguard.data.tenantId}}'
                AND e.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_DRentry.data.organizationId}}'
                AND ({{node:code_node_DRentry.data.edLikeSql}})
                AND e.is_deleted = 0
                AND e.command = 'EDIT_GD'
                AND e.causation_id = 'PICKING_FC'
                AND CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.request_payload, '$.causation_job_id')) AS UNSIGNED) = j.id) AS CHAR) AS edits,
       CAST((SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('name', s.step_name, 'ref', s.result_ref))
               FROM gd_publish_step s
              WHERE s.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_DRguard.data.tenantId}}'
                AND s.job_id = '{{node:code_node_DRguard.data.jobId}}'
                AND s.is_deleted = 0
                AND s.step_name IN ('FC_F0', 'FC_HOLD', 'FC_GDS', 'FC_ABORT', 'FC_REVIEW')) AS CHAR) AS steps
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN gd_async_job j
    ON j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_DRguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.id = {{node:code_node_DRguard.data.jobId}}

script.code:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(NOW(3), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now, CAST('P' AS CHAR) AS kind, CAST(t.id AS CHAR) AS id, CAST(t.to_status AS CHAR) AS status,
       CAST(t.is_deleted AS CHAR) AS a, CAST(t.is_processing AS CHAR) AS b, CAST(NULL AS CHAR) AS c
  FROM transfer_order t
 WHERE t.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_DRguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND t.id = {{node:code_node_DRentry.data.pickingId}}
UNION ALL
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(NOW(3), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), CAST('R' AS CHAR), CAST(i.id AS CHAR), CAST(i.line_status AS CHAR), CAST(NULL AS CHAR), CAST(NULL AS CHAR), CAST(NULL AS CHAR)
  FROM transfer_order_jz8m9w3h_sub i
 WHERE i.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_DRguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND i.transfer_order_id = {{node:code_node_DRentry.data.pickingId}}
   AND i.is_deleted = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(NOW(3), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), CAST('A' AS CHAR), CAST(NULL AS CHAR), CAST(NULL AS CHAR), CAST(COUNT(*) AS CHAR), CAST(SUM(r.store_out_qty) AS CHAR),
       CAST(MAX(r.id) AS CHAR)
  FROM transfer_order_vrqs3cmr_sub r
 WHERE r.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_DRguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND r.transfer_order_id = {{node:code_node_DRentry.data.pickingId}}
   AND r.is_deleted = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(NOW(3), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), CAST('G' AS CHAR), CAST(g.id AS CHAR), CAST(g.gd_status AS CHAR), CAST(NULL AS CHAR), CAST(NULL AS CHAR), CAST(NULL AS CHAR)
  FROM goods_delivery g
 WHERE g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_DRguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND g.id IN ({{node:code_node_DRentry.data.gdIdsAllSql}})
   AND g.is_deleted = 0
